description: Change a rate-limit rule: enable or disable it (status), or change its limit, window, route, method, key or expiry. Only the fields you pass change. Write action; requires confirmation.

confirm.description: Required for write actions. Must be true.

duration.description: New lifetime from now, for example 2h.

ip.description: New IPv4 address or CIDR filter ("" for any IP).

keyName.description: Header or cookie name for keyBy header/cookie.

reason.description: Short human-readable reason for the write action.

status.description: active enables the rule, disabled stops enforcing it.

name: securenow_rate_limit_update
title: Update Rate Limit
